description: Approximate feature illustrations for the README, not native screenshots or runtime evidence.
shared_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: public GitHub README feature illustration for Automexia Terminal. Make a polished, crisp, very legible landscape 1536x1024 bitmap, straight-on flat desktop UI illustration. This is an approximate explanatory illustration of existing features, not a native screenshot. Match observed app style: near-black navy #020d17 terminal background, almost-black header, pale cool gray monospace text, bright cyan active focus outline, blue rounded rectangular global tabs, green lambda shell prompt, small rectangular colored prompt tags, fine charcoal pane dividers. App uses Windows-style minimize/maximize/close symbols at top right; do not show macOS traffic lights. Slim title bar, app icon is a simple split-pane outline, global tab strip, generous terminal text size. Avoid browser chrome, fake sidebars, neon glow, photographic monitors, perspective, giant empty regions, dashboard charts or invented buttons. Use only fictional short demo data and repository-relative paths beginning ./demo; NO personal names, machine/host names, absolute filesystem paths, addresses, account IDs, real clusters, credentials or cloud connections. Above app frame put the provided title with a small AUTOMEXIA TERMINAL label. Under the app include two short explanatory annotations outside the UI, and in bottom-right a clearly legible label reading exactly "ILLUSTRATION • NOT A SCREENSHOT". Exact readable monospace text matters. Keep screenshot-like app as dominant 80% of composition.

images.prompt:
Title: "One workspace. Several sessions."
Show one app window with two global tabs named "Development" (active) and "Operations" (inactive), then a plus icon. Body has THREE panes: large left half full height, top-right and bottom-right stacked, with continuous dividers. Cyan border around active left pane. Within the left pane show a separate smaller PANE-LOCAL tab strip "Shell" active and "Tests" inactive, then plus; it must visually live below the global tab row inside that pane only. Left content: blue "PowerShell" tag and purple "main" tag; path "./demo"; green lambda and "git status"; output "On branch main", "nothing to commit, working tree clean"; next command "ls"; file listing with colored folder/file icons, "src", "assets", "Cargo.toml", "README.md", then idle lambda. Top-right pane: prompt "cargo test", output "running 24 tests", "test result: ok. 24 passed", next idle lambda. Bottom-right pane: prompt "docker ps", simple columns "NAME   STATUS", row "web    Up 2 minutes", "cache  Up 4 minutes", next idle lambda. Each pane has small footer "PANE 1/3", "PANE 2/3", or "PANE 3/3", and "UTF-8". No fake live metrics. Outside-frame annotations: "Global tabs group your work" and "Split panes and pane-local tabs keep sessions separate". Thin discreet callout lines to global tab strip and local tab strip. Keep session UI hierarchy unmistakable.

Title: "A quick look, right in the terminal."
One global tab "Assets" active and "Shell" inactive. One pane. Show prompt tags "PowerShell", "main", path "./demo/assets", green lambda "ls". File listing has three entries with small purple image icons: "coast.png", "forest.jpg", "study.webp", with "coast.png" selected in cyan underline. A compact pinned image-preview CARD overlays the right half of that terminal pane; subtly outlined dark card with a small header exactly "coast.png" and "960 × 640 • PNG", and a gorgeous clean coastal landscape photo inside with pale cliffs, teal ocean and blue sky. Photo must be fully bounded by the card, with landscape aspect ratio kept. There is terminal text visible behind and left of the card; this is a quick-look overlay, not a separate file explorer, editor or webpage. Card footer text exactly "← → Previous / next    Esc Close". Bottom of terminal idle lambda. External annotations: "Hover a local image path; click to pin" and "Browse visible images with arrow keys". Small line points from selected coast.png to preview card.

edit_prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. This is an approximate README feature illustration, not a native screenshot. Correct exactly two text colors in the supplied image: in the worker-demo row (second data row), recolor the STATUS word "Running" from green to AMBER, exactly the same amber as that row's "0/1" READY value. The entire "Running" word in the worker-demo row must be amber because the pod is only partly ready. In the job-demo row (fourth data row), recolor the READY text "0/1" from amber to CYAN, exactly the same cyan as "Completed" in that row. Keep every word, every numeral, row order, layout, background, border, title, annotations, dimensions and other colors unchanged. In particular api-demo "1/1 Running" stays green, queue-demo "0/1 Pending" stays amber, job-demo "0/1 Completed" must both be cyan, and cache-demo stays red. Preserve the visible "ILLUSTRATION • NOT A SCREENSHOT" footer. Do not add any new content.
